messages.text: Hi Mike — I'm Sarah, an AI researcher with HeliumDeploy. Thank you so much for taking 25 minutes to do this — it really means a lot. Honestly, the more you can share with me, the better — we're aiming for about fifteen hundred words of feedback together, so please don't worry about going long. The founders read every word of these chats, so what you say actually shapes what HD does next. As a thank-you you'll get a $50 discount code at the end. So — to kick us off, tell me about your mining setup right now. What are you running, where, and what are you trying to figure out next?

I have four uh, six zero twos and a Thor, um, p c o four, which just got from you guys, and I have another one, uh, arriving shortly. Just getting used to the mining process. I also have a a couple of um, z nine minis that I'm not currently using. Just because of the power consumption. But, uh, yeah. That's what I currently have. Uh, I run it in my home, in a basement, lower, you know, I'm looking for the lower power consumption, uh, products. So that's why I have, uh, so far a couple, uh, the four bit axes. And the, uh, the two thaws.

Yeah. Uh, looks good. About twelve. Twelve cents.

I honestly don't know, and I'd rather not guess. I've just sent your question to our support team, along with
